\[

\[

\]
Because \(\mathbf b\) bisects \(\angle AOC\), by Angle Bisector Theorem in triangle \(AOC\):
\[
\frac{AB}{BC}=\frac{OA}{OC}=\frac{|\mathbf a|}{|\mathbf c|}.
\]

\[
\frac{1}{t-1}=\frac{\sqrt{66}}{|\mathbf c|} \implies |\mathbf c|=(t-1)\sqrt{66}.
\]

=|\mathbf a|^2+2t\mathbf a\cdot(\mathbf b-\mathbf a)+t^2|\mathbf b-\mathbf a|^2.
\]
Now \(\mathbf a\cdot(\mathbf b-\mathbf a)=\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b-|\mathbf a|^2=28-66=-38\), \(|\mathbf a|^2=66\).
So
\[
|\mathbf c|^2=66-76t+24t^2.
\]
Set equal to \(66(t-1)^2\):
\[
66-76t+24t^2=66(t-1)^2=66t^2-132t+66
\]
\[
